mapper.select: SELECT FROM practice WHERE id=#{id} FOR UPDATE
SELECT id,practice_id,question_id,order_no,option_order,selected_answer,is_correct FROM practice_item WHERE practice_id=#{practiceId} ORDER BY order_no
mapper.sql: WHERE p.student_id=#{studentId} AND p.archived=0 AND p.status='SUBMITTED' AND p.course_id=#{courseId}
mapper.select: SELECT CAST(p.id AS CHAR) practiceId,CAST(p.course_id AS CHAR) courseId,c.name courseName,ch.name chapterName,p.source_type sourceType,p.question_count questionCount,p.correct_count correctCount,ROUND(p.correct_count*100.0/p.question_count,1) accuracy,p.submitted_at submittedAt FROM practice p JOIN course c ON c.id=p.course_id LEFT JOIN chapter ch ON ch.id=p.chapter_id ORDER BY p.submitted_at DESC,p.id DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
mapper.sql: WHERE p.archived=0 AND p.status='SUBMITTED' AND p.student_id=#{studentId} AND p.course_id=#{courseId}
mapper.select: SELECT CAST(p.id AS CHAR) practiceId,CAST(p.student_id AS CHAR) studentId,u.username,u.real_name studentName, CAST(p.course_id AS CHAR) courseId,c.name courseName,ch.name chapterName,p.source_type sourceType, p.question_count questionCount,p.correct_count correctCount,ROUND(p.correct_count*100.0/p.question_count,1) accuracy,p.submitted_at submittedAt FROM practice p JOIN app_user u ON u.id=p.student_id JOIN course c ON c.id=p.course_id LEFT JOIN chapter ch ON ch.id=p.chapter_id ORDER BY p.submitted_at DESC,p.id DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
SELECT name FROM chapter WHERE id=#{chapterId}

WITH attempts AS (SELECT p.*,COUNT(*) OVER(PARTITION BY chapter_id) attemptCount, ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY chapter_id ORDER BY submitted_at DESC,id DESC) rn FROM practice p WHERE p.student_id=#{studentId} AND p.source_type='CHAPTER' AND p.status='SUBMITTED' AND p.archived=0) SELECT CAST(ch.id AS CHAR) chapterId,ch.name chapterName,ch.sort_order chapterNo, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM question q WHERE q.chapter_id=ch.id) questionCount, COALESCE(a.attemptCount,0) completedAttempts,CAST(a.id AS CHAR) latestPracticeId, a.correct_count latestCorrectCount,ROUND(a.correct_count*100.0/a.question_count,1) latestAccuracy,a.submitted_at lastSubmittedAt FROM chapter ch LEFT JOIN attempts a ON a.chapter_id=ch.id AND a.rn=1 WHERE ch.course_id=#{courseId} AND ch.is_current=1 ORDER BY ch.sort_order,ch.id
